record.provider: 模力方舟 / moark (formerly Gitee AI) — model & dataset hub

free_tier.stated: Not published. Gitee documentation covers AI-model hosting where models are stored as LFS files in repositories. The platform mirrors open models and datasets, but publishes no separate storage allocation for the AI platform.

egress.terms: Not stated; model downloads are free and anonymous. Gitee's general terms do not charge egress.

record.tooling: git and git-lfs for model files, web downloader, and platform API and CLI at ai.gitee.com/docs. Documentation endpoint moark.com/docs returns HTTP 404.
record.chaining: Inherits the Gitee account quota if the repo lives on Gitee proper. Which would cap it at 5 GB, making chaining the only route and a poor one.

record.limits_note: The parent Gitee free account is the constraint and it is documented precisely: 1,000 repos, 500 MB per repo, 50 MB per file, 5 GB total across all personal and organizational repos, plus 100 MB per attachment and 1 GB of attachments per repo.
record.reliability_note: Gitee has a history of public-repo review and takedowns of content it dislikes, which for a mutable repo is a technical availability risk. The AI platform itself is a rebrand in progress (Gitee AI -> 模力方舟 -> moark.com), so links churn.

record.notes: Not published. Gitee documentation covers AI-model hosting where models are stored as LFS files in repositories. The platform mirrors open models and datasets, but publishes no separate storage allocation for the AI platform.

dead_end.why: Not published. Gitee's help centre documents the AI-model hosting flow (models are stored as LFS files inside a Gitee-style repo and the UI annotates each with its size), and 模力方舟 is presented as the successor platform that '同步了全球最热门的开源大模型和数据集' (mirrors the world's most popular open models and datasets).
